lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the gills, arranged in at least four distinct horizontal rows forming a semi-regular grid pattern across the mid-to-lower flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a series of grid-like anchor nodes primarily visible in the posterior half of the shark's visible flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Several small, dark, elongated silhouettes are visible near the ventral-anterior edge of the first two gill slits.
